Claim amendment (2026-11-15T19:15Z) to claim 6899732043 · Branch `claude/project-thread-g15lbf` unchanged.

File surface adds `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, append-only:
1. One new entry at the end of `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS`: a `git grep` over the tracked corpus, matched only in the execFile form (`'git', ['grep'`). Indexes 0–2 are unchanged. Measured by the card thread on main `895783a1`: on the tree it matches `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` only, and the bare `spawnSync('grep'` in `check-skill-compatibility-version` does not match.
2. Two self-test cases beside the existing spelling cases: one where the `git grep` spelling is recognised and one where it is not.

Why: the root fix is the existing whole-tree-population marker on `check:adr-anchors` (the grammar 8 families already use; no new syntax), and `dispatch-gates` refuses that marker unless the gate's own source carries a recognised repo-root walk. Its refusal text says to extend `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS` with a self-test case. Rewriting the scan to `ls-files` just to satisfy the pattern would route around that refusal, so it is not taken. WIDE-population was rejected because it drops the family from `--commands`, which is the opposite of the acceptance.

Serial: PR #34080 (in the merge queue) and card #34084 also edit `dispatch-gates.mjs`, in other regions. Whoever lands later resolves the conflict. `Fixes #34086` stands.
